name: PlaNet
summary: PlaNet introduced the Recurrent State-Space Model, which splits latent state into a deterministic recurrent path and a stochastic path, capturing both reliable dynamics and genuine uncertainty. Planning runs entirely in latent space with the cross-entropy method, achieving performance comparable to model-free agents while using around 50 times less environment interaction.
innovation: The RSSM latent dynamics architecture, still the backbone of the Dreamer line.
Latent-space online planning that never renders a predicted image during control.
matters: Made model-based RL from pixels competitive, which is the precondition for robot world models.
limits: Online CEM planning at every step is computationally expensive and myopic beyond short horizons.
lineage: The World Models idea rebuilt with a principled latent dynamics model and planning instead of evolution.
